pred_diagnosis: Internal Hernia after Roux-en-Y Gastric Bypass

1: Differential diagnoses included internal herniation and adhesive bowel obstruction.
2: There were no signs of anastomotic leak, strangulation, or bowel obstruction.
3: Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT demonstrated a cluster of small-bowel loops in the left upper quadrant, positioned anterior to the splenic flexure.
The central mesenteric vessels exhibited a spiral (whirl) pattern, with congestion of mesenteric fat and stretching and convergence of vessels.
